text:
sam: Quick note from docs QA: when a v1 request is routed to a v2 model alias the client's stop list can be ignored for streaming responses. Minimal repro below.

clare: can you paste the exact repro curl?

sam: repro: `curl -i -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"legacy-3r","input":"hello","stop":["<END>"]}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/responses` follow 307 -> `/v2/responses?model=rwd/3r-v2` and stream shows tokens after `<END>`.

sdk-li: thanks. Action items from SDK side: add small helper `v1Compat.wrapForV2(req)` that preserves stop metadata across redirects and ship a patch release. I'll draft snippets for TS + Py.

infra-aron: quick runtime note: proxy rewrites model param but doesn't forward the stop header into the v2 stream metadata. Two options: copy header on redirect (fast) or enforce server-side stop on v2 runtime (safer). Propose copy + unit tests this week.

pm-kate: product wants a clear migration note. Legal (law-ron) requested 30 days notice before behavioral changes; we should add a deprecation banner and migration checklist.

law-ron: confirm we need 30 days. If docs publish a planned date and we follow it, we're good. Share banner text before merging.

sam: docs plan: (1) add a "Streaming caveats when routed to v2" section in migration guide; (2) update all streaming examples to prefer `rwd/*-v2` aliases; (3) include emergency workaround using `x-rwd-force-stop: true` header. Also add a tiny `rw-migrate` CLI example that lists swapped routes.

sdk-li: sample snippet I'll add to SDK PR: 
TS: `for await (const ch of client.responses.stream({model: 'rwd/3r-v2', input: 'hi', stop:['<END>']})) { process.stdout.write(ch.text) }`
Py: `for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='rwd/3r-v2', input='hi', stop=['<END>']): print(chunk.text, end='')`

infra-aron: scheduling proxy change Friday 02:30 UTC (low traffic). Will add smoke test that simulates a 307 redirect and asserts stop preservation.

ci-bot: Created job docs-smoke/stream-stop-checker; will run on staging after deploy.

clare: I'll open the docs PR with examples + FAQ + banner draft. PR link will be posted here. Please include banner copy and legal-approved date.

pm-kate: once infra confirms deploy date, we'll set deprecation date and send comms to active customers.

sam: thanks all 44d. Keeping this thread as the coordination source. Ping me for repro logs if needed.
